Game Overview

At its heart, Circle Block Bird is a casual game about guide your bird through dynamic puzzles by removing blocks and dodging traps. Each level challenges your strategic skills as you navigate around bombs and saws to unite the bird with the pig. With engaging physics and charming visuals, Circle Block Bird offers delightful problem-solving fun for all ages.
